jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
Your Role
As a Functional QA Engineer / Tester with Capgemini, you will help ensure the quality of the Interoperable Europe Portal by preparing and executing functional test scenarios for monthly releases, documenting evidence, logging defects, supporting user acceptance testing, and contributing to release demonstrations and periodic testing reports.
In This Role You Will
Analyse requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, improvements, and defect fixes to determine test coverage.
Author, review, update, and maintain functional test scenarios in Jira or the agreed test-management tool.
Execute the required functional and regression scenarios for each Portal release, contributing to a recurring suite of approximately 60 scenarios per month.
Support validation of one planned major monthly release and additional minor or urgent releases when required.
Record test evidence, results, status, and traceability accurately for each release.
Log clear, reproducible defects in Jira, including steps, expected and actual results, severity, evidence, and environment details.
Retest corrected defects and perform targeted regression testing before closure.
Collaborate closely with the technical team, QA Lead, business stakeholders, and specialist testers.
Support the identification and coordination of users for relevant user acceptance testing activities.
Contribute to demonstrations of completed features and to quarterly reports covering tests, defects, risks, results, and release status.
Your Profile
Professional experience in manual and functional testing of web applications, portals, or digital services.
Strong knowledge of test-case design, exploratory testing, regression testing, and defect lifecycle management.
Hands-on experience with Jira or a comparable test and defect management tool.
Ability to interpret requirements and acceptance criteria and convert them into effective test scenarios.
Experience creating clear test evidence and high-quality defect reports.
Understanding of web technologies, browser behavior, APIs, and integration testing fundamentals.
Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a user-focused quality mindset.
Ability to manage recurring release deadlines and multiple test cycles.
Strong collaboration skills and confidence working with technical and business stakeholders.
Clear professional English, both written and spoken.
Nice to have
Experience testing Drupal-based platforms or complex content-management systems.
Knowledge of WCAG 2.2 accessibility testing and web usability principles.
Exposure to API testing, SPARQL endpoints, performance testing, or test automation.
Experience supporting UAT, release demonstrations, or European public-sector projects.
What You Will Love About Working Here
Community & Support: Join an active network of quality engineers and testers who share best practices, automation techniques, and insights on Agile and DevOps.
Learning & Development: Benefit from a dedicated Testing Curriculum, personalized digital learning paths, and certification programs to deepen your technical expertise, and your leadership
Flexibility & Balance: Benefit from hybrid working policies that allow you to manage your time and work location effectively.
Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

jobs.title: QA Engineer (Automation)
jobs.description:
WHY SPEKTR
At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.
Compliance, built like product.
Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.
We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.
It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.
$26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.
Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.
Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.
THE OPPORTUNITY
We’re looking for a
QA Automation Engineer
to help us build and scale high-quality, reliable products as we grow.
You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams to build and maintain the automated testing that keeps our platform behaving exactly as intended, especially across complex, AI-driven, API-first systems. If you enjoy writing solid test code, finding the edge cases others miss, and helping teams ship with confidence, you’ll feel at home here.
What You Will Be Doing
Test Automation: Design, build and maintain scalable automated E2E test suites using Playwright, using LLMs to speed up test generation and maintenance.
Agent Validation: Build and run test cases and evals that validate AI agent behaviour, so our autonomous compliance workflows are accurate, explainable and hallucination-free.
API & Data Validation: Test RESTful APIs and validate complex data flows, checking data directly in the database so frontend, backend and AI systems stay fully aligned.
CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so AI model updates and deployments don’t break existing logic.
Production Issues: Investigate production issues, reproduce failures and turn them into automated regression tests.
Quality Practices: Work with engineers and PMs early in development on testability and acceptance criteria, and contribute to our QA processes and standards.
What We Are Looking For
The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.
Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks like Playwright.
API & Database Skills: You’re comfortable navigating backend services, testing RESTful APIs and verifying data integrity with SQL.
Maintainable Test Code: You don’t just write scripts. You write clean, reusable tests that the rest of the team can build on.
Communication Skills: You can explain a bug or edge case clearly to both a PM and an engineer.
Detail Obsession: You have a “sixth sense” for where a system might break and a genuine passion for delivering a polished user experience.
Curiosity about AI testing: Exposure to testing LLM-based features or eval frameworks is a strong plus.
OUR TECH INTERESTS
Languages: JavaScript / TypeScript
Testing: Playwright
AI/ML: LLM Prompting, LangChain/AutoGPT concepts, Evals frameworks
Infrastructure: API-driven architectures, SQL databases, CI/CD pipelines
OUR PROCESS
Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)
Technical Interview (30 minutes)
Technical Interview (60 minutes)
How To Apply
We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.
spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

jobs.title: QA Engineer with German
jobs.description:
Who We Are
Our client is looking for a Software Tester / QA Engineer ideally performing also automated testing.
As a Software Tester / QA Engineer, you will support our development team in quality assurance and the further development of the KIDICAP application in the public-sector environment. You will work closely with developers, business analysts, and the customer to ensure that new and existing functionalities are implemented reliably and to a high quality standard.
What You’ll Be Doing
Analyzing functional and technical requirements and deriving suitable test scenarios and test cases
Planning, creating, executing, and documenting software tests
Performing functional tests, regression tests, as well as integration and end-to-end tests
Testing new functionalities, enhancements, and bug fixes
Quality assurance of frontend, backend, and interface functionalities
Testing legal and functional changes within the KIDICAP application
Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects
Re-testing fixed defects and performing regression tests
Supporting the creation and further development of automated tests
Maintaining and enhancing existing test cases and test documentation
Analyzing and documenting test results
Close collaboration with developers on defect analysis and resolution
Supporting release and acceptance tests
Actively contributing to the continuous improvement of our QA and testing processes
What We’re Looking For
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field
At least 5 years of experience in software testing / quality assurance
Experience in creating and executing manual and, ideally, automated tests
Good knowledge of functional tests, regression tests, as well as integration and end-to-end tests
Experience with test and defect management
Knowledge of Tosca or comparable test automation tools is an advantage
Experience with Jira or comparable tools
Basic knowledge of REST APIs / interface testing
SQL or database knowledge is an advantage
Experience in an agile development environment
Analytical and structured working style as well as a strong quality mindset
Strong communication skills and enjoyment of collaboration in international and distributed teams

jobs.title: QA Engineer with SQL/Database Testing
jobs.description:
Who We Are
We don’t just test software, we elevate it! The QA & Agile Competence Center at NTT DATA Romania brings together specialists in test automation and quality engineering, ensuring fast, reliable, and safe delivery across all projects. With strong expertise in UI & API automation, continuous testing, performance testing, and agile frameworks, we build scalable automation frameworks, integrate quality into CI/CD pipelines, and enable teams to deliver high‑quality releases at speed. In every industry we support — from Automotive to Finance and e‑Commerce — we turn quality into a competitive advantage.
We’re looking for a highly engaged Quality Assurance Engineer with German to join one of our projects within a large‑scale telecommunications environment. The project aims to validate and ensure the quality of legacy applications as they are transformed into modern, scalable, and user‑centric web interfaces, delivering seamless digital experiences for millions of customers. This role offers the opportunity to work on a modern and technically complex project, where quality plays a key role in ensuring reliable and high‑performing solutions at scale. You will support the end-to-end testing of applications and ensure quality across the entire application flow, from UI and API interactions through to database validation. The role requires strong test automation experience, ideally with Playwright, as well as the ability to work with SQL to validate data and investigate application behavior at database level.
What You'll Be Doing
Design, develop and maintain automated end-to-end test scenarios for web applications.
Perform automated testing across UI and API layers.
Validate application behavior across the complete flow: UI/API → application/backend → database.
Use SQL queries to verify that data generated or modified through UI or API interactions is correctly persisted in the database.
Compare expected vs. actual results at database level.
Validate the outcome of transactions and API calls directly in the database.
Use SQL to identify, prepare and validate test data required for different testing scenarios.
Investigate defects and perform troubleshooting across UI, API and database layers.
Analyze test results, identify root causes of failures and document defects.
Collaborate with developers and other project stakeholders to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
What You'll Bring Along
Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a comparable field
Hands-on experience developing and maintaining UI and REST API test automation using Playwright or Cypress
Experience in manual software testing, preferably within Agile environments (e.g., Scrum)
Solid knowledge of testing methodologies, test management, and QA documentation
Experience working with test management tools such as Jira and Xray
Experience writing and maintaining test specifications using Gherkin syntax
Understanding of BDD concepts (hands-on experience with Cucumber is a plus, not mandatory)
Strong analytical skills and high attention to detail
Basic understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC)
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) is an advantage
Good knowledge ofSQL, particularly for:
querying and validating application data;
verifying transaction/API results;
comparing expected and actual data;
preparing and identifying test data;
troubleshooting application issues.
ISTQB certification is considered a plus
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German are mandatory for this role
Experience with PL/SQL and/or Oracle databases is nice to have

jobs.title: QA Support Technician IRC305694
jobs.description:
Description
You will be embarking on a project for one of the most well-known IT industry companies in the world.
Your role will be to test and support our client’s new communications and conferencing platform on the OEM devices provided by our client’s partners. This project is at the beginning, so there’s plenty of room to grow and explore new opportunities within. As part of this project, you will be treated as one of the team members from our client, enjoying a very innovative and high-tech office, with all the benefits included (parties, lunch at the office, parking spot, etc.).
Requirements
Required qualifications
2–4 years of experience in technical support, QA, or customer-facing engineering support for software or devices.
Excellent written and spoken English. Most partner communication is written, asynchronous, and with non-native speakers, so clarity and tone matter as much as technical accuracy.
Hands-on experience with a bug tracking or issue management system (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira), including triage, severity classification, and status reporting.
Comfortable reading device logs, reproducing issues step by step, and explaining technical findings to engineers and program managers.
Organized and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple partner channels and open-issue backlogs without letting items age.
Able to work in-office in Iasi and occasionally flex hours to overlap with Redmond- and Asia-based partners.
Preferred Qualifications
Strongly preferred: Android knowledge, including familiarity with AOSP, Android system architecture, adb and logcat, OTA updates, and Android device bring-up or certification.
Experience supporting ODMs, OEMs, or hardware partners, or working in a device manufacturer or SoC vendor environment.
Exposure to client devices.
Basic scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, or shell) for log analysis and test automation.
Job responsibilities
Partner support and inquiries
Act as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned ODM and SI development partners, answering technical/program questions and routing unresolved items to the appropriate MDEP engineer or program manager.
Own MDEP partner Teams channels: monitor daily, acknowledge posts promptly, keep threads organized and answered, and ensure every item has an owner.
Help partners access and use entitled support resources, including build drops, release notes, documentation, integration guides, and MDEP validation test suites/tools.
Provide overflow support to OEM distribution partners on bug management and Teams questions, in coordination with the MDEP OEM engagement team.
Bug and issue management
Triage partner bugs and feature requests in IMS, ensuring clear descriptions, reproduction steps, logs, supporting artifacts, severity, and priority; follow up when information is missing.
Reproduce issues on MDEP reference devices where possible, document findings, and hand off well-formed bugs to MDEP engineering.
Track issues through resolution, keep partners updated on status and target releases (sustaining or enhancement), and close the loop when fixes ship.
Maintain partner bug/inquiry backlogs and flag aging, blocking, or recurring issues to client stakeholders.
Partner onboarding and program operations
With the Senior TPM, run the technical side of partner onboarding, including repository/IMS access, Teams setup, first build drop, and MDEP support walkthrough.
Follow and help refine MAPP operating processes established by the Senior TPM, including check-in cadence, support hygiene, and reporting.
Contribute to weekly support reporting covering volume, response times, open/aging issues, and partner readiness for upcoming releases.
Capture recurring questions as FAQ/documentation improvements and feed them back to MDEP documentation owners.
Testing and validation (overflow)
When support volume allows, execute system test and validation passes on MDEP reference devices under the MDEP test manager, including sustaining release verification and MDEP OTA testing.
Log test defects to the same quality standard expected of partners and help maintain the reference device pool in Iasi.
What we offer
Empowering Projects:
With 500+ clients spanning diverse industries and domains, we provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies. As a team, we engineer digital products that positively impact people’s lives.
Empowering Growth:
We foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development. Our dedication is to provide timely and comprehensive assistance for every consultant through our dedicated Learning & Development team, ensuring their continuous growth and success.
DE&I Matters:
At GlobalLogic, we deeply value and embrace
diversity
. We are dedicated to providing
equal
opportunities for all individuals, fostering an
inclusive
and empowering work environment.
Career Development:
Our corporate culture places a strong emphasis on career development, offering abundant opportunities for growth. Regular interactions with our teams ensure their engagement, motivation, and recognition. We empower our team members to pursue their career goals with confidence and enthusiasm.
Comprehensive Benefits:
In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment.
Flexible Opportunities:
At GlobalLogic, we prioritize work-life balance by offering flexible opportunities tailored to your lifestyle. Explore relocation and rotation options for diverse cultural and professional experiences in different countries with our company.
About GlobalLogic
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer (Finance and Data), B2B Contract
jobs.description:
Length:
3 months initially, with an extension likely
Start date:
ASAP
Location:
Remote, within 80km of Iași, Cluj-Napoca or Bucharest
Hours:
9am to 5pm UK time (11am to 7pm in Romania)
Why this role
You're the tester people go to when the numbers don't add up.
In a lot of QA roles that work gets squeezed in around regression testing. Here, it's the main job.
What's in it for you
You'll work on the financial side of a busy UK online marketplace, where getting the data right really matters.
You'll have time to investigate problems properly, trace them back to the cause and see them fixed.
You'll work alongside experienced QA engineers at hedgehog lab, so you won't be on your own.
Who You'll Be Doing It For
hedgehog lab is a digital product consultancy and certified B Corp with 20 years of experience. We help public and private sector clients across retail, health tech and financial services with their digital transformation.
You'll be placed with one of our clients, a UK online marketplace, in a product team of engineers and QA.
What You'll Be Doing
Testing ledger and financial processes to make sure every transaction is recorded correctly.
Checking reports against source data and finding where they don't match.
Using SQL to dig into data issues and work out what's causing them.
Writing clear bug reports that engineers can act on quickly.
Mostly manual testing, with some automation where it saves time.
What You Get
A fully remote contract on UK hours, starting with 3 months and an extension likely.
A clear focus on financial data quality, with the support of a wider QA team.
What You'll Need
Senior QA experience, with a good amount of it spent testing financial systems, ledgers or accounting data.
Confidence writing SQL queries to investigate data.
Experience reconciling figures between systems and checking reports for accuracy.
A methodical way of working out why data is wrong.
Some test automation experience, or a willingness to build it.
Fluent English, written and spoken.
Availability now or at very short notice.
Nice to have
Playwright, JavaScript or TypeScript.
Experience in ecommerce or online marketplaces.
How To Apply
Apply with your CV. If your experience matches what we need, we'll be in touch to arrange a call.
